entities.name: Shūhei Fujisawa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shuhei Fujisawa  was a Japanese author, whose real name was Tomeji Kosuge. Over fifty of his books were published through the course of his lifetime, including both full-length novels and short story anthologies. The focus of his writing was historical fiction. Before he became an author, he had been a business journalist and before that a high school teacher.
